Prefer to read it? The short version
  1. Client brief: one online form with built-in intelligence, no more to-ing and fro-ing. One click converts the brief into the hotel and venue RFQ.
  2. Sourcing: more than 1,000 hotels and venues. Smart 4-way matching of your brief to their credentials. One button sends a branded RFQ to those you select. Forward the quotes to the Smart Inbox, where they are read and compared side by side. Pick the winner(s) and one push sends the acceptance and rejection emails.
  3. Events and guests: a full RSVP system with guest templates and your choice of client, agency or event branding. Smart travel planning builds the transfer manifest for multiple suppliers. Travel bookings come in by email with no manual entry, and client spreadsheets are mapped to GroupBook's fields. Late changes are tracked, and crunch-period emails tell the event manager what is unresolved.
  4. Companion: a live task tracker showing what is done, in progress, overdue and next.
  5. Reconciliation: forward the financial documents, let the data be extracted and matched to the card statement, and press AutoReconcile.
